findings.claim: A hand-mirrored memory (no import_map row) whose content equals a whole Engram observation imported as several parts no longer finds that observation: mirrorsOf matches only mapped memories with the same content hash, and a part holds only part of the content, so the memory is not bridged to a page keyed engram:O and could be promoted a second time.
evidence: Before: the Engram composition hashed the full observation (CardContentHash(o.Title, o.Content), lineage.go:30). After: mirrorsOf calls MappedTwins(card.Project, card.ContentHash), matching m.content_hash among memories with an import_map row (store.go:147-148).
A part of a split observation holds partial content, so its hash cannot equal the whole observation hash; L41 lists the multi-part count as unverified; no test covers it.
